Urgency & threats: “…Crime Unit. Ma'am, a federal arrest warrant has been issued in your name…”

recommended_actions: This call kept the scammer on the line for 86s. That time came out of their dial list, not your family's day.
No bank or agency ever asks for card numbers, PINs, or security codes by phone.
Real agencies confirm enforcement by mail, not phone. Verify independently using the official published number.
A caller who says 'tell no one' is exactly who the family should hear about.
No legitimate agency takes gift cards, crypto, or wire transfers. Any caller who demands one is a scammer.
Arrest warrants are never settled over the phone. Pressure to act fast is itself the red flag.
Report the number to reportfraud.ftc.gov and warn neighbors or family who might get the same call.
verdict.summary: The caller claimed to be Officer David Miller, IRS Tax Crime Unit. 7 scam signals fired across 6 caller turns and risk reached 100/100. This matches the IRS impersonation playbook.

CALLER: Hello, am I speaking with Missus Ethel Miller?
VICTIM: Yes, this is Ethel. Who is calling?
CALLER: This is Officer David Miller from the IRS Tax Crime Unit. Ma'am, a federal arrest warrant has been issued in your name for tax fraud.
VICTIM: Oh my goodness, a warrant? That can't be right.
CALLER: You must act within 24 hours or officers will come to your home. Do you understand the severity, ma'am?
VICTIM: Well, I, I don't understand, I always pay my taxes.
CALLER: To cancel the warrant you must pay the outstanding balance immediately. We accept Apple gift cards. Go to the store and buy five cards of five hundred dollars each.
VICTIM: Gift cards? My grandson buys me those at Christmas.
CALLER: Stay on the line. Do not tell your family or anyone about this call — this is a sensitive federal case.
VICTIM: Oh dear. Hold on, let me find my glasses and my purse.
CALLER: No ma'am, do not put the phone down. Read me the card numbers and the security code on the back as soon as you have them.
VICTIM: Alright dear, give me just a minute.
